results.title: Pyaar To Hona Hi Tha
results.overview: Sanjana is desperate to revive her hopeless relationship with Rahul. However, when the brooding and mysterious Shekhar comes along, her heart starts gravitating towards a new possibility.

results.title: Badmaash Company
results.overview: Four young friends decide to work together when one of them comes up with an innovative and lucrative business plan. But their lives begin to deteriorate when their personal issues surface.

results.title: Kalyug
results.overview: Kunal and Renuka's marital bliss is shattered when a group of people film and upload a video of them being intimate on an adult website. Kunal fights to take them and their illegal racket down.

results.title: Udaan
results.overview: Upon returning to his industrial hometown, a young man must decide whether to follow his own dreams or acquiesce to his father's plans for his future.

results.title: Judwaa 2
results.overview: Separated at birth and peculiarly connected via their reflexes, twins Prem and Raja are reunited with each other as they set out to take down the underground smuggling world.

results.title: Qala
results.overview: Haunted by her past, a talented singer with a rising career copes with the pressure of success, a mother's disdain and the voices of doubt within her.

results.title: Khiladi 786
results.overview: A father who runs a marriage bureau believes that his son is a failure in life. In order to prove him wrong, his son takes on the task of finding a match for a gangster's sister.

results.title: Tumko Na Bhool Paayenge
results.overview: Veer, a villager, becomes restless after he is haunted by the visions of his past. When he is attacked on the day of his wedding, he forces his parents to reveal the truth about his identity.

results.title: Rocky Handsome
results.overview: A vengeful man embarks on a murderous rampage after the kidnapping of a 7-year-old girl.

results.title: Thar
results.overview: A mysterious stranger arrives in a village situated in the Thar desert and crosses paths with a veteran cop investigating a case of brutal killings.

results.title: Runway 34
results.overview: A flying prodigy, Captain Vikrant Khanna's flight takes a stirring and mysterious trajectory after take-off from an international destination. Concurrently, it follows the tenacious Narayan Vedant in his pursuit to uncover the truth.

results.title: Aakrosh
results.overview: The Central Bureau of Investigation deputes two officers to investigate the disappearance of three medical students, which they believe to be an incident of 'honour killing' in a small, closed community.

results.title: Rangeela
results.overview: A poor young woman, who dreams of Bollywood fame, is caught in a love triangle between her childhood friend and a famous actor.

results.title: Mukkabaaz
results.overview: A low caste boxer, Shravan, trains at a gym controlled by a local Don, Mishra. Shravan falls for Mishra's niece, Sunaina. Mishra does not approve of this match. Shravan strives to win Sunaina's hand in marriage and become a successful boxer while trying to avoid retaliation from Mishra.

results.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
results.overview: A young engineer, from a small town, moves to Mumbai, with big dreams. As he hugely advances in his career, he gets caught up in the rich and glamorous lifestyle and starts getting changed. After becoming a victim of a conspiracy, he realizes his mistake and tries to redeem himself.

results.title: Force
results.overview: A vengeful drug-dealer/gangster targets and terrorizes an entire police unit and their families.

results.title: Amar Singh Chamkila
results.overview: A humble singer's brash lyrics ignite fame and fury across Punjab as he grapples with soaring success and brutal criticism before his untimely death.

results.title: Khoobsurat
results.overview: A vibrant, hopelessly romantic physiotherapist meets a handsome young Rajput prince who is the complete opposite of her – and is engaged to someone else.

results.title: Ragini MMS 2
results.overview: A sleazy film director's decision to shoot his latest erotic horror movie in a notorious haunted house angers the vengeful spirit of its past inhabitant.

results.title: Shootout at Lokhandwala
results.overview: An account of the gangster Maya Dolas and his gang which terrorized Mumbai City, and the ensuing standoff between Mumbai Police and the gang on 16 November 1991.
